_comment: Per-AMC SIF portfolio-disclosure sources. SIFs disclose holdings BI-MONTHLY (a SEBI rule); AMFI only links out to each AMC's own site, so holdings are fetched per-AMC. 'nav_sif' matches the 'sif' field in nav_data.json so disclosed funds map to dashboard scheme codes. discovery.method = http_listing | template | manual. adapter = sebi_xlsx (the SEBI-standard monthly-portfolio layout all AMCs use; also unpacks a zip-of-xlsx). Files that need a browser (WAF/Akamai/SPA) are pinned as manual URLs, refreshed via a headless browser or --file. Adding an AMC = one entry here (+ a new adapter only if the layout is genuinely different).

apex.name: Apex SIF
apex.managers: Lovelish Solanki, Rohit Karan, Mohit Sharma
apex.strategy: An interval fund spreading money across arbitrage, long stocks, bonds and limited short bets (via derivatives) plus some REITs/InvITs. Returns come from steady low-risk arbitrage/debt income and equity gains, while shorts and hedging cushion losses when markets fall.

titanium.name: Titanium SIF
titanium.managers: Suraj Nanda, Akhil Mittal, Hasmukh Devji Vishariya
titanium.strategy: Buys stocks it expects to rise (long) and bets against stocks it expects to fall (short) via shares and derivatives, shifting net market exposure dynamically to profit in both rising and falling markets.

equitylong.managers: Suraj Nanda, Akhil Mittal, Hasmukh Devji Vishariya
equitylong.strategy: Actively buys stocks it expects to rise and shorts stocks it expects to fall via shares and derivatives, shifting net exposure (~-25% to 100%) to make money in both rising and falling markets from stock selection on both sides.

hybrid.managers: Suraj Nanda, Akhil Mittal, Hasmukh Devji Vishariya
hybrid.strategy: Mixes equities, debt and derivatives -- long positions to benefit from rising markets, short/arbitrage positions to cushion falls, and debt for steadier income -- aiming for smoother risk-adjusted returns.

dynasif.name: DynaSIF SIF
dynasif.strategy: Buys stocks it expects to rise while short-selling (via derivatives) those it expects to fall, aiming to make money in both up and down markets from stock-picking rather than market direction.

equitylong.strategy: Buys stocks it expects to rise while short-selling (via derivatives) those it expects to fall; returns come mainly from stock-picking skill rather than overall market direction.

alloc.managers: Harsh Agarwal, Milan Mody, Rahul Khetawat
alloc.strategy: Dynamically shifts money between equities, bonds and commodities, using long-short/hedging (options, arbitrage) to cut downside. Returns come from asset-class rotation plus instrument selection.

extop.managers: Harsh Agarwal, Mayur Patel, Milan Mody, Pranav Mise
extop.strategy: Focuses on mid/small-caps outside the largest 100 stocks, holding those it expects to outperform while shorting (up to ~25% unhedged) those it expects to lag.

arudha.name: Arudha SIF
arudha.strategy: Mostly holds listed Indian stocks it expects to rise while placing limited bets against stocks it expects to fall, plus covered calls and a small debt sleeve -- aiming for equity-like returns with lower volatility.

equitylong.strategy: Mostly holds listed stocks it expects to rise while shorting (via derivatives) those it expects to fall and writing covered calls; returns come from long picks, shorts, call premiums and a small debt sleeve.

hybrid.managers: Kapil Kankonkar, Nilesh Saha, Brijesh Shah, Debraj Lahiri
hybrid.strategy: Puts up to ~65% into short-duration bonds for steady income and at least 35% in fully-hedged (market-neutral arbitrage) equity; returns come mainly from debt plus low-risk arbitrage, for steadier returns with limited stock-market volatility.

discovery._note: F5 WAF blocks curl; fetch via browser or --file

isif.name: iSIF
isif.managers: Rajat Chandak, Ayush Shah, Manish Banthia, Akhil Kakkar
isif.strategy: Mostly buys equities for growth while holding debt for steadier income, using derivatives to take limited short bets against stocks/bonds it expects to fall.

hybrid.managers: Rajat Chandak, Ayush Shah, Manish Banthia, Akhil Kakkar
hybrid.strategy: Mostly buys equities for growth while holding debt for steadier income, using derivatives to short stocks/bonds it expects to fall. Returns come from stock gains, bond interest and profiting on both rising and falling positions.

equitylong.managers: Mittul Kalawadia, Nitya Mishra, Sri Sharma
equitylong.strategy: Mainly buys listed shares for long-term growth, able to short (via derivatives) up to 25% of the portfolio on stocks it expects to fall.

extop.managers: Sankaran Naren, Manan Tijoriwala, Divya Jain
extop.strategy: Invests in mid/small-caps outside India's largest 100 stocks, buying promising ones and shorting overvalued ones (up to 25%) via derivatives.

alloc.managers: Ihab Dalwai, Sharmila D'silva, Masoomi Jhurmrvala, Manish Banthia, Akhil Kakkar, Gaurav Chikane
alloc.strategy: Dynamically shifts money across shares, bonds and commodity/equity derivatives with limited short positions; returns come from moving between asset classes plus long/short bets.

discovery._note: WAF blocks curl; zip of 4 xlsx; fetch via browser

altiva.name: Altiva SIF
altiva.managers: Bhavesh Jain, Bharat Lahoti, Dhawal Dalal, Kedar Karnik
altiva.strategy: A hybrid long-short fund mixing equities, debt and derivatives — holding stocks it expects to rise while hedging/shorting via derivatives, with a debt sleeve for steadier income; aims for equity-like returns with lower volatility.

discovery._note: Akamai WAF blocks curl -- fetch via browser same-origin. Only Oct-2025 Hybrid portfolio disclosed so far.

diviniti.name: Diviniti SIF
diviniti.strategy: Mainly buys shares it expects to rise and takes limited short bets (via derivatives) on shares it expects to fall, to cushion losses when markets drop. Returns come from stock selection on both the long and short sides.

magnum.name: Magnum SIF
magnum.strategy: Earns steady income mainly through low-risk arbitrage (small cash-vs-futures price gaps) and options strategies like covered calls, while keeping some money in stocks for growth. Returns come from hedged income trades, some equity gains, and debt interest.

arthaya.name: Arthaya SIF
arthaya.strategy: Invests mainly in Indian stocks it expects to rise while taking limited short bets against stocks it expects to fall, across all company sizes. Returns come from stock-picking on both sides plus adjusting the long-vs-short balance to the market outlook.

sapphire.name: Sapphire SIF
sapphire.strategy: Buys large, mid and small Indian companies it expects to rise while placing limited bets (capped at 25%) against shares it expects to fall, using a rules-based quant model. Aims to make money in rising and falling markets while cushioning downturns.

platinum.name: Platinum SIF
platinum.strategy: Spreads money across hedged arbitrage trades, high-quality bonds and a controlled slice of equity (using option collars and special situations that cap gains and losses). Returns come mainly from interest income and market-neutral arbitrage, with a limited hedged-equity portion.

redhex.name: RedHex SIF
redhex.managers: Shriram Ramanathan, Venugopal Manghat, Praveen Ayathan, Mayank Chaturvedi
redhex.strategy: Puts about half its money into low-risk high-quality bonds and market-neutral equity arbitrage for steady income, and half into yield-enhancement bets plus REIT/InvIT units, keeping bond maturities short (~1-2 years).

wsif.name: WSIF
wsif.strategy: Holds listed Indian stocks it expects to rise while taking limited short bets (via derivatives) against stocks it expects to fall; returns come from stock selection on both the long and short sides.

quant.name: qsif
quant.managers: Sandeep Tandon, Ankit Pande, Sameer Kate, Sanjeev Sharma, Jignesh Shah
quant.strategy: Quant's VLRT-driven long-short strategies that buy stocks expected to rise and short those expected to fall across equity, hybrid, ex-top-100, sector-rotation and asset-allocator mandates.

discovery._note: One of the oldest SIFs (NAVs from Oct 2025); discloses bi-monthly (Jan/Mar/May 2026...). Files under /Admin/disclouser/ (curl-able) but the listing is a JS accordion year>month>fund; URLs pinned per period.

summit.name: Summit SIF
summit.strategy: Buys stocks it expects to rise and short-sells (via derivatives) those it expects to fall, aiming to make money in both rising and falling markets from stock selection.

discovery._note: NFO mid-Jul-2026; no portfolio yet. Clean OData API at /api/default/documents once live.

infinity.name: Infinity SIF
infinity.managers: Kalpesh Jain, Hiten Shah, Abhishek Bisen
infinity.strategy: Mixes equities, arbitrage and debt with long and short (derivative) positions, aiming for steadier returns across market conditions; debt (Bisen) provides income while the equity long-short book drives growth.

discovery._note: Ops began ~09-Jul-2026; no portfolio yet. Radware WAF; needs browser. Re-check ~mid-Aug 2026.

prism.name: Prism SIF
prism.managers: Tanvi Kacheria, Siddharth Deb, Virendra Kumar
prism.strategy: A hybrid long-short strategy combining equities, debt and derivatives with long and short positions, aiming for steadier risk-adjusted returns; overseen by the SIF CIO.
